source: Li et al 2018 arXiv:1803.00022v2 sec2.1 Eqs4,5; SPARC Table2 definitions
radius: r(D)=r0 D/D0 at fixed angular sample
templates: v_k(D)=v_k0 sqrt(D/D0) for disk,bulge,gas; fixed angular shape; Upsilon held fixed
template_inclination: standard catalog-level transform keeps templates fixed under global i; rephotometry/warped-disk geometry not recoverable
residual: r_trans=y(i)-vm(D); JD=-dvm/dD; Ji=-y0 cot(i0) per rad
fixed_frame_residual: r_nom=y0-vm(D) sin(i)/sin(i0); JD=-dvm/dD; Ji=-vm0 cot(i0) per rad
dist_cross_covariance: D/i independent; correlation unknown, set zero only as declared sensitivity assumption
sigma_sys: B0 nominal-frame additive floor; B1 intrinsic deprojected floor projected with sin(i)/sin(i0); neither choice claimed original documented nuisance generative law
data_dependent_vs_model_jacobian: propagating transformed observations uses y; marginalizing a fixed-data mean uses vm. Distinguish; signs kept in output.
